A gitoid may represent either an [Artifact Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-identifier-types) for the software artifact or an [Input Manifest Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#input-manifest-identifier) for the software artifact's associated [Artifact Input Manifest](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-input-manifest); this ambiguity exists because the Artifact Input Manifest is itself an artifact, and the gitoid of that artifact is its valid identifier. Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).

Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element refers to a disk image that can be written to a disk, booted in a VM, etc. A disk image typically contains most or all of the components necessary to boot, such as bootloaders, kernels, firmware, userspace, etc.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hsCodes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The [Harmonized System (HS)](https://www.wcoomd.org/en/topics/nomenclature/overview/what-is-the-harmonized-system.aspx) of tariff nomenclature is an internationally standardized system of names and numbers, defined by the World Customs Organization, used to classify traded products.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: mailingList
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the mailing list used by the maintainer for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fail
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates a failed evaluation where the requirement or condition is not met.
The amount or measure of a bulk product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: custody
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Custody refers to the responsibility, control, and safekeeping of an asset, person, or legal entity. It involves both physical possession and legal authority over something or someone.
Artifact representing a serialization instance of SPDX data containing the definition of a particular Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: highAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 4 - High automation. The system performs parts of its mission without external intervention.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: metrics
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to metrics related to package such as OpenSSF scorecards.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bower
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Bower package. The package locator format, looks like `package#version`, is defined in the "install" section of [Bower API documentation](https://bower.io/docs/api/#install).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: doesNotAffect
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Vulnerability has no impact on each `to` Element. The use of the `doesNotAffect` is constrained to `VexNotAffectedVulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: specification
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A specification is a detailed document (or set of documents) that describes the requirements, design, behavior, or other characteristics of a system, component, or process so that all stakeholders have a clear, unambiguous reference.
A prescribed change to a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityOther
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to related security information of unspecified type.
Type of support that is associated with an artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: blake2b512
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: BLAKE2b algorithm with a digest size of 512, as defined in [RFC 7693](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc7693/) Section 4.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: productMetadata
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to additional product metadata such as reference within organization's product catalog.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerabilityExploitabilityAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange (VEX) statement which provides information on whether a product is impacted by a specific vulnerability in an included package and, if affected, whether there are actions recommended to remediate. See also [NTIA VEX one-page summary](https://ntia.gov/files/ntia/publications/vex_one-page_summary.pdf).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runtimeAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a runtime analysis report for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: releaseHistory
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a published list of releases for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: md5

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: medium
